name: components/list
description: A composable list primitive for building content feeds, task lists, and catalog-style rows with slot-based item structure. Supports visual variants, density sizing, horizontal or vertical item layout, split lines, and helper states for selected or expanded rows.
useCases: Activity feeds and notification timelines with custom item media and actions
File and project lists that need compact, default, or large density options
Card-like vertical list items with description, metadata, and aside content
Loading and empty states with consistent list skeleton and empty placeholders
usage: import { List, ListBody, ListItem, ListItemMain, ListItemTitle } from "shadcn-solid-components/components/list"
